title: Poiseuille's Law
text: To determine by what factor the pressure difference must increase to keep the same flow rate when the radius of a blood vessel decreases, use Poiseuille's law, which states: $$Q=\frac{\Delta{}P\,\pi{}r**4}{8\eta{}L}$$.

title: Set Up the Proportion
text: Since $$Q$$ must remain constant, we can set up the following proportion: $$\frac{\Delta{}P_{2}}{\Delta{}P_{1}}=\left(\frac{r_{1}}{r_{2}}\right)**4$$.
